threads.body: [Testing] Require the equivalent variant to be wired as well. As written, `wired` only qualifies `testExperimental`, so when only test sources change this guidance can accept an existing flag-on task that is not included in `check`/CI. That also loses the PR's stated exception specifically for existing wired variants.
